## Documentation domains

### 1. Authoritative German game concept

The [German concept](content/de/index.md) is the content source of truth for
game vision, story, world, mechanics, prototypes, decisions, and approvals.
Only documents with `status: approved` are binding.

### 2. English documentation status

The [English status page](content/en/index.md) explains why detailed
translations are unavailable before overall concept completion and individual
source-document approval.

### 3. Technical developer documentation

The [developer area](developer/index.md) contains English game-owned technical
architecture, implementation documentation, decisions, and ExecPlans.

### 4. Inherited Forge2D technical foundation

The [Inherited Forge2D technical foundation](forge2d-template/index.md)
preserves template runtime architecture, tooling, plans, reports, decisions,
and release history. It is not the `ether-food` game concept.

### 5. Reserved future areas

- [Player guide](player-guide/index.md)
- [In-game help](in-game-help/index.md)
- [Case studies](case-studies/index.md)
- [Release manual](release-manual/index.md)

Documentation media follows the [media structure](assets/README.md). Repository
workflows are documented in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). The project uses the [MIT License](../LICENSE).
